justification: Tier 0 of the brief content-enrichment plan: fix the satellite key-mapping bugs that silently nulled data the brief already fetches. Confirmed live (2026-06-22) the services emit different keys than the brief reads. Bushfire read outputs['rfs'][...] + outputs['cross_overlays'] but the service emits flat is_bushfire_prone/designation_category/estimated_bal_band/designation_guideline/fire_signal + compliance.cross_overlays (whole card was dead). Flood read epi_flood/jrc_occurrence_pct/wofs_frequency_pct but the service emits epi_flood_class (a class string, not a bool)/jrc_water_occurrence_pct/dea_wofs_frequency_pct (3 fields always null; #588's null->'Couldn't retrieve' meant it said couldn't-retrieve even on success). Shadow scenarios read date_label/time_label/overlap_pct but the service emits label/time_local/shadow_overlap_fraction(0-1)/shadow_direction_deg/overlaps_subject_lot (4 fields blank). Complementary to #587/#588 (those fixed timeouts, not keys). No DB query / schema change.

pre_impl.existing_data: Read both sides of the boundary live + by source: services flood_truth.py:1387-1411, bushfire_prescreen.py:557-572, shadow_detector.py:275-286 emit the real keys; the brief's _build_bushfire_detail/_build_flood_detail and the inline shadow map in _build_neighbourhood read different keys. Verified live against demo addresses (Concord/Belmore/Hurstville).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The brief assumed nested outputs['rfs'] for bushfire, a bool 'epi_flood', and scenario keys date_label/time_label/overlap_pct. Reality: flat bushfire keys + compliance.cross_overlays; epi_flood_class is a class string ('none'/'flood_planning_area'); shadow emits label/time_local/shadow_overlap_fraction (0-1). #588 then rendered the resulting nulls as 'Couldn't retrieve', so a successful fetch was reported as a failure.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses existing services unchanged; only remaps the dict keys the brief reads. Widens 3 existing models (BushfireDetail +is_bushfire_prone/fire_signal, FloodDetail +epi_flood_label, ShadowScenario +shadow_direction_deg/overlaps_subject_lot) and extracts _build_shadow_result from the inline block in _build_neighbourhood so the mapping is unit-testable. No new service, query, or table.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Services return graceful empties (None) for non-applicable addresses; epi_flood is None when not assessed, False only when the class is 'none', True when a flood class is present. Overlap arrives as a 0-1 fraction and is converted to percent.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Backend Python only (Pydantic models + builders). Frontend renders these DataFields generically; no .tsx change in this PR.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: bushfire card blank on every run; flood JRC/WOfS/EPI showed 'Couldn't retrieve' even on success; shadow scenarios missing date/time/overlap/direction. After: each surfaces the real values the service already returned.

functions.name: _build_bushfire_detail
functions.input: the raw dict returned by run_bushfire
functions.output: BushfireDetail with is_bushfire_prone/category/bal_estimate/vegetation_type/fire_signal/cross_overlays from the real flat keys + compliance.cross_overlays
functions.if_none: returns None when input is falsy

functions.name: _build_flood_detail
functions.input: the raw dict returned by run_flood
functions.output: FloodDetail; epi_flood = None if no class / False if 'none' / True otherwise, plus epi_flood_label, jrc_water_occurrence_pct, dea_wofs_frequency_pct
functions.if_none: returns None when input is falsy

functions.name: _build_shadow_result
functions.input: the raw dict returned by shadow_detector run_shadow
functions.output: ShadowResult; per-scenario date_label/time_label/shadow_length_m/overlap_pct(fraction*100)/shadow_direction_deg/overlaps_subject_lot from the real keys
functions.if_none: returns None when input is falsy; required str fields fall back to '' via (get() or '')

values: N/A - no regulatory values computed; pure key remap + presentation.
queries: N/A - no database or API query added.

break_it.repro: feed the legacy-key dict to the builder
break_it.how: test_brief_satellite_field_mapping.py has *_does_not_read_legacy_keys tests asserting old keys produce None, so a revert fails the suite

break_it.scenario: Flood service returns no EPI class (not assessed)
break_it.how: epi_flood = None when class is None; False only when class == 'none'; test_flood_missing_class_is_unknown_not_false pins it

break_it.scenario: Shadow scenario has an explicit None label/time, or fraction shown as raw percent
break_it.what_happens: validation error on required str field, or 0.42 shown as 0.42%
break_it.how: (get() or '') guards None on required str fields; fraction*100 -> percent; test asserts overlap_pct == 42.0

break_it.scenario: A pre-existing test encodes the bug (fake keys) and masks a regression
break_it.what_happens: green tests, broken prod (how the bug survived)
break_it.how: updated those fixtures in test_satellite_integration.py to the real service-output keys so they test reality
